Read the following extract on sustainable development and the Indira Gandhi Canal command area and answer the questions that follow.
"Canal irrigation has increased cultivated area and the intensity of cropping in the region. Stage I of the command area lies in Ganganagar, Hanumangarh and the northern part of Bikaner districts. Stage II of the command area covers Bikaner, Jaisalmer, Barmer, Jodhpur, Nagaur and Churu districts and uses lift canals."
(i) Which crop is NOT advisable in the Indira Gandhi Canal command area because it needs too much water? (1)
(ii) Explain the term 'sustainable development' as it relates to this theme. (1)
(iii) Explain the reason behind the following: Sustainable development became a central idea in the 1980s. (1)
items.answer: (i) Rice (ii) Development that meets the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs. (iii) Concern grew about environmental damage caused by economic development.
items.markingKey: 1+1+1 marks: (i) Rice (ii) Development that meets the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs. (iii) Concern grew about environmental damage caused by economic development.

items.stem:
Study the extract below and answer the questions.
"Planning involves thinking, formulating a scheme and implementing a set of activities to achieve a goal. The Hill Area Development Programme aimed to harness indigenous resources of hill areas through horticulture, plantation agriculture, animal husbandry and small-scale industry. The Drought Prone Area Programme aimed at providing employment and creating productive assets in drought-prone areas. Regional planning aims to reduce disparities in economic development between regions."
(i) Explain the term 'Hill Area Development Programme', which is related to the theme of the extract. (1)
(ii) Using the extract and your own knowledge, explain the following: The Drought Prone Area Programme emphasised irrigation and afforestation. (1)
(iii) A student concludes: "The Hill Area Development Programme was started in the First Five Year Plan." Use your knowledge of the chapter to evaluate this conclusion. (1)
items.answer: (i) A programme initiated in the Fifth Five Year Plan for the development of hill areas. (ii) These measures help to reduce the effects of drought and create productive assets. (iii) The conclusion is wrong: It was started in the Fifth Five Year Plan.
items.markingKey: 1+1+1 marks: (i) A programme initiated in the Fifth Five Year Plan for the development of hill areas. (ii) These measures help to reduce the effects of drought and create productive assets. (iii) The conclusion is wrong: It was started in the Fifth Five Year Plan.
